verdicts.decision_note: The source identifies a material unresolved choice between DSCR-only sizing and sizing that also meets an equity-IRR target.
The client sets the model's payment-sizing logic and acceptance thresholds: approximately 1.65x minimum DSCR and 16–20% minimum equity IRR, rejecting a DSCR-only result with negative equity returns.
The client resolves the material sizing ambiguity, allowing implementation of the availability-payment calculation to proceed under the confirmed targets.
